items.title: Alterac Valley Adjustments in WoW: Forever - November 25
items.summary: Alterac Valley Adjustments in WoW: Forever - November 25 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) We’ve seen that players in Alterac Valley were frequently completing the battleground without capturing the objectives, so we’ve made some adjustments to incentivize a focus on the objectives rather than rushing to kill the enemy faction’s General. The intent with these adjustments is for Honor gains to be relatively the same and reputation to be increased per match. Additionally, the difficulty of enemy creatures inside Alterac Valley has been lower than intended, so we’ve increased that, and we’ve made some adjustments to how the Warmasters/Marshals and Faction Generals behave to improve their sturdiness. Player versus Player Alterac Valley Reputation and Honor from killing the enemy faction General has been significantly reduced. The reputation from objectives (Towers, Graveyards, and Mines) has been increased to compensate. Honor from these objectives has been slightly increased as a redistribution. Reputation from killing enemy NPCs has been increased. Damage and Health has been increased for all enemy creatures in Alterac Valley. Warmasters/Marshals will now leash if they leave their respective rooms, and they now aggro from further away. Generals and Warmasters/Marshals all are stronger if the objectives are present. Moonkin Form now also increases Arcane and Nature damage done by 10% while in that form. items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever Comic: "Al'Aketh Rising"
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever Comic: "Al'Aketh Rising" Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Constable Aonda of the Skyborne travels into a remote settlement that appears to be under strict control. Prisoners march under close guard, strangers smile with an eerie conviction, and an uncomfortable silence provides cover for a growing threat. As she plays along to get closer to the truth, she finds herself overwhelmed by hidden agendas and fanatic devotion. And in a land ruled by wind, blind devotion can become a storm. Join Constable Aonda for a special reading of World of Warcraft: Forever's newest motion comic, “Al'Aketh Rising”. Read By : Sam Slade as Constable Aonda Written By : Robert Brooks Art & Cover : Stefano Porcu Colors : Mauro Gulma Letters : AndWorld Design Downloadable PDF Read more stories and stay up to date on the latest World of Warcraft news at worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/news .
